messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired > service=inference-router prod-us-east-1 metric=latency_p95 value=1320ms threshold=1200ms (alert id: pd_87321)

olivia: Acked. I'm oncall. Pinging infra to confirm whether this is noisy or real customer impact :eyes:

sam: thx, olivia. any 5xx spikes? if not maybe tail latency from cold kv or autoscaler?

olivia: No 5xx spikes in logs. 200s still high p95. quick check:
```
# top error + latency counts (past 5m)
curl -s http://metrics.internal/service/inference-router?range=5m | jq .p95
{"p95": 1320}
```

mika: I see a big jump in prefix-cache miss rate around 10:11:30, aligns with router p95 rise. Autoscaler also started two new pods right around then.

raj: There's a synthetic canary run from ci-canary at 10:12 that ramps to 20r/s, might have saturated warm paths. traffic rate graph attached (small spike).

olivia: ok, probable cause = short-lived canary + cold KV cache causing request tails. No customer 5xxs, looks transient. I'll try a quick mitigation: scale router pool + set throttle on canary.

olivia: running: `kubectl scale deployment inference-router --replicas=8 -n prod`

deploy-bot: Scale request accepted for inference-router -> desired=8.

sam: while scale finishes, i'll add a short suppression rule in incidentbot to avoid repeat flapping pages for same metric for next 5m. Otherwise PD will spam.

sam: command: `incident-bot suppress add metric=latency_p95 service=inference-router duration=300s reason="transient warmup"`

incident-bot: Suppression added. Will suppress repeated pages for metric latency_p95 on inference-router for 300s.

olivia: router pods now Ready. p95 trending down to ~520ms.

mika: started a KV pre-warm job to fill common prefixes (low cost, 30s).

raj: canary throttled back to 2r/s from 20r/s. keeping it paused for now.

olivia: handing off to mika for postmortem/next steps. I'm out in 10.

mika: taking it. I'll keep an eye for 10m then file follow-up. initial notes: probable noisy canary + cache coldstart -> transient p95 flare. No customer impact detected (no 5xx, no error spikes in customer-facing endpoints).

mika: followup actions planned:
- adjust canary ramp schedule to be more gradual
- add KV pre-warm during canary ramp for hot prefixes
- add a narrow incidentbot suppression for autoscale churn windows
- add runbook step to check prefix-cache miss rate on paging

olivia: :thumbsup: good. closing my ack, handoff complete.

incident-bot: Alert pd_87321 auto-resolved (condition cleared). PagerDuty incident closed.

mika: will open a short retro ticket and assign to platform (priority=low) to tune canary and run pre-warm. No customer-facing action required.

raj: noted. thanks all for quick triage.

sam: recording brief blameless note in #incidents and will attach graphs.

mika: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
